items.signal_prefix: Cloudflare 10-Q (Q2 2026): restructuring and other charges o

set.signal: Cloudflare 10-Q (Q2 2026): restructuring and other charges of $150,693 thousand in the quarter took the GAAP loss from operations to $205,696 thousand (operating margin (30)%); channel partners rose to 31% of revenue from 25% a year earlier; GAAP gross margin 72%. It again expects significant component shortages in memory (DIMMs), enterprise SSDs, CPUs and HDDs that may raise the cost of its network equipment and servers.

items.reason: Common stock issued as acquisition consideration is the price of an acquisition (skill §2: never a deal price); the operating facts stay.
